# Planted bugs of a session's end under end-to-end TLS (scripts/go-mutants.sh
# client/nfnet/testdata/mutants.txt, make test-go-mutants, in make ci): each
# line "<mutant> | <file> | <exact line text> | <replacement> | <test>".
# Lane PIPERESET: a Close after the peer's close_notify closed the session
# whole before the FIN behind it arrived; the peer's CloseWriteSync read it
# as a reset (link ENDACKTRUTH; nfltr-pipe's relayed dialer exited 6).
close-before-fin | ../tlsend/tlsend.go | 	take := c.raw.notified.Load() && syncsEnd(c.raw.Conn) | 	take := false | TestNF1CloseTakesThePeersEnd
# Lane PIPERESET: CloseWrite under TLS was crypto/tls's alone (the
# close_notify), the FIN left to Close: a peer's Close waited for it.
closewrite-tls-only | ../tlsend/tlsend.go | 	if cw, ok := c.raw.Conn.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }); ok { | 	if cw, ok := c.raw.Conn.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }); false && ok { | TestNF1CloseWriteEndsTheSession
